channel.title: Security Briefing — weownit.net
channel.description: Selected network and cybersecurity research: attacks, vulnerabilities and practical checks, with solutions scoped to your environment.

item.title: PAN-OS management access: check exposure and update
item.description: A management interface vulnerability can allow authenticated attackers to execute code. Check exposure and the vendor’s fixed versions.

item.title: From VPN to ransomware: review GlobalProtect access
item.description: Unit 42 research updated in October connects VPN exploitation with ransomware and access to virtual infrastructure.

item.title: MythicRatatoskr: command and control hidden in a mesh network
item.description: New research on a 2025 incident: what to examine when the real communication destination is not a conventional C2 domain.

item.title: PHP2Shell: exposed applications and infrastructure management
item.description: From application runtimes to management interfaces: confirm the affected product before choosing the fix.

item.title: Gheist: when a GitHub token exposes deployment secrets
item.description: CI/CD abuse can reach service and infrastructure credentials. Deleting the workflow does not close the incident.

item.title: Stolen Microsoft 365 sessions: why a password reset is not enough
item.description: Token replay and identity persistence: review sessions, devices, MFA methods and email rules.

item.title: From a fake installer to Akira ransomware
item.description: A DFIR case study follows a July 2025 intrusion through to ransomware.
